# Kynoptic

> A local-first activity awareness layer for Windows. Kynoptic records
> which applications you use, when your machine is busy, and what
> changes on your system - entirely on your machine - and answers
> questions about it later through a CLI, a local dashboard, or MCP.

## What it is

- 40 system monitors (foreground window/app switches, keyboard/mouse
  activity counts, idle time, battery, network, devices, processes,
  audio, brightness, Wi-Fi, and more). 14 are enabled by default
  (pure Win32 APIs, zero subprocesses); 26 more are opt-in.
- Raw events are stored untouched in SQLite. Aggregate tables are
  derived read caches only; the raw layer is append-only and is never
  truncated or cleaned up automatically.
- Status: v0.1, active development. Language: Rust. License:
  Apache-2.0.

## Privacy boundary

- No account, no telemetry, no analytics, no network calls. Data never
  leaves the machine by default.
- Keyboard and mouse are stored as per-minute counts only - never key
  contents. Per-key detail is opt-in via settings.
- The dashboard and MCP server bind to 127.0.0.1 only.

## Architecture (three crates, plus a tray shell)

- `crates/core` - collectors, event pipeline, SQLite storage
  (numbered migrations), queries, monitor registry
  (`crates/core/src/registry.rs` is the single source of truth for
  what is enabled by default).
- `crates/cli` - the `kynoptic` / `kynoptic-ctl` binary: `now`,
  `query`, `stats`, `collect`, `dashboard`, `probe`, and the MCP
  launcher. Includes a local-only read-only web dashboard.
- `crates/mcp` - MCP server over stdio JSON-RPC 2.0.
- `crates/tray` - pure Win32 tray shell hosting the collector and
  dashboard in one process.

## MCP tools (five)

`get_current_status`, `get_summary`, `get_timeline`, `get_anomalies`,
`wait_for` - all read locally collected data; nothing is uploaded.

## Key documents

- [BENCHMARKS.md](BENCHMARKS.md) - reproducible performance numbers
  (idle CPU, memory, startup, storage per event, query p95 on a
  1M-event database); the fact-check source for any overhead claims.
- [APP.md](APP.md) - extended workspace docs, including the 40-monitor
  table with sensitivity labels.
- [CODE_NOTES.md](CODE_NOTES.md) - design and carve-out decisions.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) / [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) /
  [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Build and test

Requirements: Windows 10/11, stable Rust toolchain (MSVC target).

```bash
cargo build --workspace
cargo test --workspace
```
